tickets.title: Run a first local switching simulation
tickets.delivers: Run the local application, select a breaker in an explicitly synthetic source-to-LV-bus network, switch it, and see the resulting source connectivity.
criteria: The local browser application starts with documented development commands and a clearly identified synthetic model; it is not presented as the actual network.

A versioned model identifies assets, terminals, connections, source attachments, a transformer relationship, an LV bus endpoint, supported states and a starting configuration independently of diagram coordinates.
Users see a single-line diagram, select a breaker, inspect its identity/state, change between the fixture's supported states, and see updated connectivity on the affected path.
The simulation-session interface owns state changes and returns coherent observable results; UI components do not implement a second connectivity engine.
Malformed model structure, missing references and unsupported state requests produce clear errors instead of silently dropping data or replacing a valid session.
Meaningful tests through the session boundary and a small browser check demonstrate the complete switching behaviour without testing traversal internals.
Choose and document the initial application/tooling decisions needed for this slice without adding a backend, live equipment integration, PDF runtime requirement or network editor.

tickets.title: Explore alternate supplies and explain switching impacts
tickets.delivers: Toggle sources and switch alternative routes, then inspect affected assets and trace the supply paths that remain available.
criteria: A synthetic model demonstrates multiple enabled sources, a bus tie, alternate paths and a loop; source availability is exposed as a session action and UI control.
Opening one path leaves an asset connected when an alternative enabled-source path remains; disabling a source recomputes the same model without changing unrelated device states.
Selecting an asset shows explanatory source paths; a switching/source action lists affected assets and highlights changed and remaining paths.
An unchanged connectivity classification is distinguishable from a changed supply route where the available explanation changes.
Session tests cover single-path loss, surviving alternate supply, bus-tie operation, source loss and loop handling; a browser check exercises source control and path inspection.

tickets.title: Explore earth connectivity and source-to-earth conflicts
tickets.delivers: Operate earth switches in a synthetic network and independently inspect source connectivity, earth connectivity and conflicts.
criteria: The model and session represent earth terminations and the fixture's supported earth-switch states explicitly.
Users inspect source and earth connectivity independently, with explanatory text as well as visual indications.
A modelled enabled-source-to-earth path is highlighted as a source-to-earth conflict; the indication alone does not create an undocumented switching prohibition.
Separate circuits with earth connections are not connected to one another through a shared-earth through path, and earth is not treated as an electrical source.
Session tests and a browser check demonstrate earthing an otherwise source-disconnected section and the fixture's source-to-earth conflict.

tickets.title: Enforce physical interlocks and explain blocked controls
tickets.delivers: Try allowed and prohibited device changes, see the documented model condition that blocks an action, and see unresolved interlocks disable affected controls.
criteria: Represent physical-interlock conditions, their evidence/review status and affected controls separately from an empty rule list.
A synthetic fixture explicitly defines breaker/earth-switch interlock conditions; blocked requests are rejected through both the UI and the session interface with an explanation.
A rejected request changes no device/source states or connectivity results and is not treated as an accepted action.
An unresolved interlock is visibly flagged and disables affected switching, without inventing keys, operating sequences or generic installed-network conditions.
Tests verify successful permitted-by-fixture transitions, rejected transitions, unresolved conditions and attempts to bypass the visible controls through the session interface.

tickets.title: Inspect provisional models without hiding uncertainty
tickets.delivers: Load a model with unresolved connections, states or source information, inspect its evidence and see unconfirmed results precisely where those gaps matter.
criteria: Model and display supported facts, provisional interpretations, unresolved questions and owner-confirmed resolutions without treating those statuses as interchangeable.
Asset/connection inspection exposes available drawing references and linked review records; a best guess is explicitly labelled unconfirmed.
Results depending on an unresolved connection, device state or source availability remain unconfirmed rather than silently defaulting to open, disconnected or unavailable.
A known source path remains identifiable when additional possible routes are unresolved; source and earth uncertainty are evaluated separately.
An off-page boundary without confirmed coverage is shown as an unconfirmed connection rather than silently removed or declared disconnected.
Session tests and a browser check demonstrate an unknown route, an unknown source, an uncertain earth connection and an unaffected known supply path.

tickets.title: Explore explicit equipment positions and winding relationships
tickets.delivers: Use synthetic multi-position equipment and a multi-winding transformer whose displayed connections and interlock results follow explicit model data.
criteria: Equipment can declare supported positions and terminal-to-terminal relationships per position, instead of being forced into a universal open/closed representation.
A synthetic multi-position device and multi-winding transformer demonstrate the needed model expressiveness through visible controls and connectivity results.
Transformer reachability and any modelled backfeed relationship are explicit; do not infer universal behaviour from the device name, nominal voltage or generic symbol.
Position changes pass through the same interlock and session validation as other switching; unsupported positions fail without mutating the scenario.
The diagram identifies the selected position and represents the corresponding connections consistently.
Session tests and a browser check cover the fixture's positions, winding relationships and blocked/unsupported changes; the synthetic rules are not presented as site facts.

tickets.title: Undo switching and restore the starting configuration
tickets.delivers: Follow accepted session actions, undo device/source changes and reset the network to its starting configuration.
criteria: Show accepted device and source actions in session history with their resulting state changes.
Undo restores the preceding accepted states and recomputes connectivity/explanations; blocked actions do not become accepted history entries.
Reset restores both starting device states and starting source availability, then recomputes the result.
History operates on the session's model and state rather than an independent UI simulation; unsupported history operations leave the session intact.
Session tests and browser checks cover switching, source toggling, a blocked action, undo and reset against a clearly identified synthetic starting configuration.

tickets.title: Navigate a connected overview and detailed substation views
tickets.delivers: Move between network overview and detailed views with pan/zoom while retaining asset identity, session state and connectivity explanations.
criteria: Represent overview/detail organisation separately from authoritative electrical connections and device states.
Provide pan/zoom and navigation to individual areas without losing the active session.
Asset selection, source connectivity and impact/path information refer to the same assets and session in every view.
Cross-area connections remain identifiable when their endpoints are displayed in different views; drawing-page boundaries do not sever topology.
Browser checks demonstrate cross-view navigation, selection, switching and inspection; session tests remain the primary rule tests.
Do not add a network-editing interface.

tickets.title: Save, share and reopen self-contained scenarios
tickets.delivers: Download a scenario file containing its original model snapshot and reopen it against a matching model version to reproduce the same scenario.
criteria: Scenario files contain the complete original network-model snapshot, model version, selected device states and source availability.
Save/load controls use the simulation-session boundary and file adapters; the original PDFs and a separate historical-model file are not needed.
Loading a compatible scenario reproduces its states, source/earth connectivity, conflicts and inspection information, including provisional evidence/review status and equipment-position data.
Validate structure, model identity and asset/state references before replacing the active session; malformed files leave the existing session unchanged and show a clear error.
Model versions identify immutable model packages; document that relevant model/baseline changes require a new version, without adding automatic scenario migration.
Tests cover a full round trip through the session and a browser file save/load interaction. Persisting the complete action history is not required.

tickets.title: Open older model versions as view-only scenarios
tickets.delivers: Open a scenario from a different model version using its saved original network, inspect it and trace paths while all electrical mutations remain disabled.
criteria: Compare the saved scenario model version with the current model version; a mismatch uses the saved original snapshot rather than remapping states onto the current model.
Clearly identify the viewed scenario's model version, the current version and view-only mode.
Pan, zoom, selection, asset inspection and existing path tracing remain usable.
Switching, source changes, undo and reset are disabled by the session interface as well as by visible controls; viewing a historical scenario does not overwrite the current model.
Tests cover matching-version exploration, a mismatched snapshot with changed topology/identities and direct attempts to bypass view-only controls.

tickets.title: Explore the real main switchroom and its review records
tickets.delivers: Inspect a source-referenced SW411 model and its feeder/interface points, with current ambiguities visible in the running application.
tickets.area: SW411 main HV switchroom and overview reconciliation
criteria: Review the detailed main-switchroom SLD, the current two-sheet OPF overview and the earlier distribution overview visually; retain document/revision/page/location references for represented assets and connections.
Render SW411 bus sections, incomers, bus tie, earth devices and outgoing feeder/interface points using stable identities and recorded drawing aliases.
Retain existing source/commissioning, feeder-identity and earthing-interlock questions as unconfirmed review records; do not resolve drawing precedence from dates or labels alone.
Affected unresolved interlocks disable controls; provisional connections/starting states produce visible uncertainty instead of an invented accepted lineup.

Start a coverage register assigning every supplied document to a network area, a duplicate/reference relationship, or a documented review disposition; assignment is not a declaration that its topology has been reviewed.

Demonstrate the area in the running diagram with asset/evidence inspection and supported scenario actions; validate structure and add evidence-based model regression checks without claiming owner acceptance.

tickets.title: Explore the power station and 33 kV supply interfaces
tickets.delivers: Inspect the station switchboards, generator/source branches and 33 kV line in the application with unresolved external connections explicitly marked.
tickets.area: Station SB01/SB02 and 33 kV overhead line
criteria: Visually review the supplied station and 33 kV line SLDs; model evidenced bus/coupler, generator/source, transformer, line switching and endpoint/interface relationships with source references.
Record named cross-area interfaces for the main switchroom and Hopper 10 without inventing missing supply paths.
Reconcile station/legacy overview references where evidence allows; retain unresolved external and future-feed arrangements as review records.
A drawn generator, outgoing connection or future feed does not automatically become a confirmed available source or an accepted starting state.
Render the station/line views with working supported state controls, source availability and path inspection; disable affected unresolved interlock controls.
Validate the model and add session-level regressions for evidenced relationships/provisional status. No source beyond the supplied coverage is silently declared disconnected.

tickets.title: Explore Crushing No. 1 through its LV bus endpoints
tickets.delivers: Inspect and simulate the SW431 area, its transformer branches and downstream endpoints, retaining the cross-tie to Crushing No. 2.
criteria: Visually review the area's HV SLDs and relevant downstream bus/incomer sheets, stopping at final LV buses.
Represent the evidenced SW431 incoming arrangement, bus/earth devices, transformer branches and SW435 cross-area tie without adding outgoing LV circuits.
Retain stable cross-area interface identities, drawing references and provisional interpretations; do not silently equate conflicting equipment labels.
Render a detailed area view and demonstrate supported switching, impact/path inspection and interlock blocks through the session boundary.
Record any additional required downstream HV equipment encountered before an LV endpoint, and model its evidenced relationships rather than prematurely stopping at an HV transformer output.
Update document coverage/discrepancy records and validate the area with structural checks and evidence-based regression cases.

tickets.title: Explore Crushing No. 2 and the HPGR branch
tickets.delivers: Inspect and simulate the SW435 area, its SW431 tie and HPGR HV branch through the final LV endpoints represented by the drawings.
criteria: Visually review the area's switchboard, transformer and downstream HV/endpoint SLDs, including the HPGR branch and any represented intermediate HV switchboard.
Preserve main-switchroom and SW431 cross-area interface identities, both incoming arrangements where evidenced, bus/earth devices and explicit winding/position relationships.
Continue through evidenced intermediate HV equipment to the agreed LV bus boundaries; exclude outgoing LV circuits.
Render the area with identity/evidence inspection, supported controls, independent source/earth status and visible interlock restrictions.
Record drawing differences and unresolved relationships/states as unconfirmed without inventing a current normal lineup.
Update coverage records, validate references and add evidence-based session regressions demonstrating the area's represented connections.

tickets.title: Explore Screening through its final LV buses
tickets.delivers: Inspect and simulate the SW421 screening supply branches down to their LV buses, with the model boundary clearly shown.
criteria: Visually review the SW421 HV sheet and the downstream incomer/bus portions needed to identify final LV endpoints, including the screening VSD and MCC bus arrangements.
Model evidenced source interface, switching/earth devices, transformer windings and bus sections with stable identities and source locations.
Show final LV bus boundaries and omit outgoing LV drive/motor circuits even where detailed sheets include their controls or interlocks.
Render the screening view with supported switching, source/earth results, impacts, tracing and evidence inspection.
Record discrepancies and unresolved physical interlocks with affected controls disabled; retain unaccepted starting states visibly.
Update coverage and demonstrate structurally valid, source-referenced area data with session regression checks.

tickets.title: Explore Desands through its final LV buses
tickets.delivers: Inspect and simulate SW426 and its Desands supply branches, including the laboratory interface and the final LV buses.
criteria: Visually review both relevant HV sheets and the downstream incomer/bus sheets needed to establish each represented endpoint and cross-area interface.
Model evidenced bus sections, switching/earth devices and transformer relationships; preserve the laboratory interface as the same connection used by the services area.
Review all supplied documents assigned to this area for in-scope information, even where their outgoing circuits are excluded; update the coverage disposition.
Render the area and demonstrate supported changes, impact/source-path inspection and independent source/earth results.
Keep disputed identities, future/spare arrangements, starting states and incomplete interlocks unconfirmed pending owner review.
Validate structure and add regression cases based on the recorded drawing evidence/provisional status; stop at final LV buses.

tickets.title: Explore lump stockpile and wet-scrubbing supplies
tickets.delivers: Inspect and simulate the connected SW454 and SW505 supply areas through their final LV buses.
tickets.area: SW454 / SW505 / lump stockpile and wet scrubbing
criteria: Visually review the supplied SW454 and SW505 HV SLDs plus the downstream bus/incomer information needed to locate final LV endpoints.
Preserve the main-switchroom interface and the evidenced SW454-to-SW505 relationship, without duplicating equipment represented on several sheets.
Represent supported switching/earth devices, bus sections, winding relationships, endpoint buses and evidenced interlock conditions.
Render each area's detailed view and demonstrate source/earth status, impacts and tracing across their interface.
Record differences, unsupported source/state interpretations and unclear interlocks for the accumulated owner review, with uncertainty/control blocking intact.
Update document coverage, validate cross-references and add evidence-based session regression checks without modelling outgoing LV circuits.

tickets.title: Explore train-loading supplies through their LV buses
tickets.delivers: Inspect and simulate SW451, its supply interface and transformer branches through final LV buses.
criteria: Visually review the train-loading HV SLDs and downstream bus/incomer details required for the agreed model boundary.
Represent evidenced switching/earth devices, bus sections, transformer relationships and final LV bus endpoints with stable identities.
Preserve the main-switchroom interface and reconcile drawing labels/aliases without silently turning spare or future branches into active equipment.
Render the area with identity/evidence inspection, supported scenario actions, impacts, tracing and interlock restrictions.
Record unconfirmed conditions and source/state questions for owner review; do not treat drawn positions as the agreed starting configuration.
Update coverage, validate the model and demonstrate source-referenced session regressions for the represented branches.

tickets.title: Explore CV006 head-end and tail-end supplies
tickets.delivers: Inspect and simulate the RM406/RM410 CV006 supply areas through their endpoint buses and documented cross-area interfaces.
criteria: Visually review the supplied CV006 overview, RMU and downstream endpoint SLDs; preserve the overhead-line and hopper-area interface references.
Represent evidenced RMU positions, earth connections, transformer relationships and endpoint buses, including downstream HV equipment where encountered.
Retain equipment aliases and differences between overview and detailed drawings as evidence-linked review records.
Render the areas and demonstrate supported switching, connectivity/impact explanations and cross-area path inspection.
Unknown external paths, starting states and interlock conditions stay explicitly unconfirmed; affected unresolved controls remain disabled.
Update document coverage and validate the complete area model with evidence-based session regressions.

tickets.title: Explore western crushing and hopper supply areas
tickets.delivers: Inspect and simulate the supplied Hopper 1/3/7/8/9 HV arrangements through their endpoint buses and cross-area connections.
tickets.area: RM417 / RM418 / RM419 and supplied Hopper 8 arrangement
criteria: Visually review the supplied Hopper 1/3, Hopper 7/8 and Hopper 9 RMU/HV SLDs, relevant endpoint sheets and supplied control schematics that establish in-scope interlocks.
Represent each evidenced area with stable asset/interface identities, explicit equipment positions and transformer relationships, continuing through downstream HV equipment to final LV endpoints.
Reconcile the supplied HP007/HP008 coverage and conflicting project/drawing references as review records rather than silently substituting one hopper's arrangement for another.
Render navigable area views and demonstrate supported device actions, source/earth results and impact/path inspection.
Only encode physical-interlock conditions supported by sources or owner confirmation; visibly retain missing conditions and disable affected controls.
Update all assigned document dispositions, validate connections and add evidence-based session regressions. If additional unresolved coverage is identified, keep it explicit for final reconciliation.

tickets.title: Explore services, workshop and conveyor supply areas
tickets.delivers: Inspect and simulate RM721 and the supplied services/workshop/conveyor/laboratory branches through their endpoint buses.
criteria: Visually review the supplied services, workshop, dump-pocket and conveyor RMU/SLD sources and their final-bus details.
Preserve the main-switchroom and Desands interface identities; do not infer the direction or existence of a cross-area connection merely from proximity on an overview.
Represent evidenced incoming, tie, switching/earth, transformer and final LV bus relationships; inspect upstream-relevant LV bus ties or sources without expanding into outgoing LV circuits.
Render the connected area views and demonstrate supported controls, source/earth connectivity, affected assets and path tracing.
Record incomplete topology, identities, source availability, starting states and interlock conditions as unconfirmed review matters.
Update coverage records and validate the area's evidence-linked model with session regression checks.

tickets.title: Explore the Hopper 10 supply and endpoint buses
tickets.delivers: Inspect and simulate the RM420/Hopper 10 arrangement from its 33 kV interface through the supplied downstream bus endpoints.
criteria: Visually review the supplied RMU and HV single-line sheets and reconcile their 33 kV line/interface references.
Represent evidenced device positions, earth connections, bus sections, transformer winding relationships and downstream HV equipment needed to reach final LV bus endpoints.
Keep drawing-label duplicates or ambiguous switch/earth tags separate from a confirmed physical identity until reviewed.
Render the area with asset/evidence inspection, supported device actions, independent connectivity results and impact/path explanations.
Keep unconfirmed interfaces, interlocks and starting configuration explicit; do not fabricate a missing endpoint or assumed source availability.
Update coverage and discrepancy records and validate the represented relationships with structural and session regression checks.

tickets.title: Explore the supplied mine and camp distribution
tickets.delivers: Inspect and simulate the mine/camp network covered by the supplied legacy and distribution drawings through its final LV buses.
tickets.area: Supplied mine distribution, camp and legacy network sheets
criteria: Visually review the supplied mine/camp distribution, camp switchboard and legacy network/fault-study SLD sheets for relevant topology, sources and endpoint arrangements.
Record which older depictions duplicate or differ from other areas without declaring the oldest or newest sheet automatically authoritative.
Represent evidenced HV supply paths, source/interface points, equipment states/positions and final LV bus arrangements, excluding outgoing LV circuits and electrical calculations.
Preserve unresolved village/mine/external coverage as explicit boundary questions; a missing exact reference filename does not itself prove missing coverage.
Render the covered areas with working supported controls, connectivity/impact/path inspection and evidence/review status.
Update the source coverage register so every assigned sheet has a disposition; validate the area model and record all unsupported extensions for final owner review.

tickets.title: Assemble the whole network and obtain model acceptance
tickets.delivers: Explore one connected whole-network model, review the accumulated discrepancies step by step and establish the owner-approved starting configuration and model version.
criteria: Combine all area models using stable identities and reconciled cross-area connection/interface records, without inventing connections to force the graph together.

Account for every supplied PDF in the coverage register: reviewed in-scope content, explicit duplicate/reference relationship or a documented disposition. Intake counts alone are not coverage acceptance.
Verify complete agreed network coverage through final LV buses, retaining any scope/boundary issue requiring the owner's decision; exclude outgoing LV circuits.
Present the accumulated discrepancies with drawing evidence and affected assets for the owner's step-by-step confirmation, and record each resolution instead of choosing drawing precedence silently.
Review the whole diagram, asset connections, source availability, supported device states, interlock rules and starting configuration with the owner.
Resolve acceptance-blocking ambiguities or obtain an explicit owner decision on their model boundary/treatment; never silently declare an unconfirmed installed arrangement correct.
Record explicit owner model acceptance and the starting configuration against an immutable model version. Preparing the package or passing software tests does not close this acceptance criterion.
Demonstrate cross-area impact/path scenarios and run structural/evidence-based regression checks against the assembled model.

tickets.title: Deliver the accepted whole-network local application
tickets.delivers: Launch the local V1 with the accepted whole-network model and use switching, impacts, navigation, history and versioned scenario files without requiring the PDFs.
criteria: Provide reproducible local startup/use instructions and package the accepted whole-network model with its agreed starting configuration.
Demonstrate overview/detail navigation, asset/source actions, independent source/earth connectivity, interlock blocks, impact explanations, tracing, undo and reset on the integrated application.
Save and reopen a matching-version real-model scenario; open a deliberately different-version snapshot in view-only mode with electrical mutations prevented.
Show that startup and scenario exploration work without the source PDFs or a separate historical model file.

Complete the approved meaningful session tests and targeted browser checks for the delivered behaviour; record any remaining limitation explicitly instead of treating unconfirmed physical facts as verified.
Confirm V1 still covers the entire accepted network through final LV bus endpoints and includes the recorded owner model acceptance.
Keep production GPT Site deployment, electrical calculations, live equipment integration and a network editor outside this deliverable.
